company.name: UpKeep
company.shortDescription: UpKeep is a platform developed for technicians and maintenance workers that provides them with a computerized maintenance management system.
company.description: UpKeep is the mobile-first CMMS/Enterprise Asset Management System helping maintenance teams deliver reliability for their facility. UpKeep has been named the #1 Maintenance Management Software by Gartner and have also been recognized as a top place to work in Los Angeles. UpKeep has over 160,000 registered users from small businesses to large enterprises including Yamaha, Jet.com, Unilever, and Constellation Brands.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile CMMS for managing work orders, preventive maintenance, assets, parts, inventory, inspections, technician activity, and maintenance records.
productsAndServices.name: UpKeep Maintenance

productsAndServices.description: An asset management system for tracking equipment throughout its lifecycle, from maintenance and operational history through longer-term reliability and asset planning.
productsAndServices.name: UpKeep Enterprise Asset Management

productsAndServices.description: An industrial IoT monitoring solution that uses sensors to track equipment conditions such as temperature, vibration, and runtime and initiate maintenance actions when readings change.
productsAndServices.name: UpKeep Edge

productsAndServices.description: A health and safety management solution for recording incidents, permits, lockout/tagout procedures, inspections, and corrective actions alongside maintenance work.
productsAndServices.name: UpKeep Safety

productsAndServices.description: A frontline learning management solution that converts standard operating procedures and completed work records into structured training courses for maintenance and operations personnel.
productsAndServices.name: UpKeep Learn

productsAndServices.description: An AI assistant for maintenance and asset operations that can generate work orders, create custom applications and checklists, convert voice input into tasks, and identify issues in operational records.
productsAndServices.name: UpKeep Nova

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,919,082 to $748,658,637, a 256.47x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 74 (-19 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-25).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
